title: DxVisualizer editor request v1
description: Unknown members are ignored. The dispatcher enforces explicit scopes. Configuration is unsupported.

typeIdentities.description: Query scopes, or exactly one type for processor operations. Assembly-qualified identities only.

assetGuids.description: Validate and processor operations: explicit nonempty main-asset scope.

processorIdentity.description: Processor operations only: concrete assembly-qualified IDataProcessor identity with a public parameterless constructor. Preview never constructs it.

confirmPaths.description: applyProcessor only: every preview path, in the same order as assetGuids. Changed paths reject the request.
